mostWorthwhile.text: Punching the star disc was the most worthwhile action: it directly made the pattern for the miniature sky.

leastWorthwhile.text: The sequence of installing and powering the lamp felt routine, with little feedback beyond the new assembly names.

surprise.text: I expected fitting the wheel to show a moving star pattern, but the chapter ended without describing its appearance.

arbitrary.text: The reflective lining’s exact purpose remained unclear; I could only infer that it would affect the light.

continue.text: I might continue to see the shadows, but this chapter’s mostly straightforward assembly did not make a strong case on its own.
